summary: Trilogy Metals closed a strategic equity investment by the United States Department of War, issuing 8,215,570 units at $2.17 per unit for gross proceeds of approximately $17.8 million. Each unit comprises one common share plus three-quarters of a warrant, sold privately under Section 4(a)(2) with warrants exercisable under Section 3(a)(9) or 4(a)(2). No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing date was disclosed. The structure resembles a PIPE-style strategic stake rather than an open-market acquisition, leaving meaningful overhang from future warrant exercise.
